title: Shanghai Grandnew Materials Technology Co., Ltd. | China Aerogel Manufacturer
content:
Shanghai Grandnew Materials Technology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese innovation-oriented company focused on aerogel applications and aerogel composite product development. Its official site states that the company was established in 2018, centers its business on aerogel composite materials, and supplies insulation and flame-retardant products for shipbuilding, pipelines, exterior walls, and new-energy vehicle battery packs.

Company Overview

Grandnew was established to expand aerogel-related business with a specialized team and industrial backing. The company publicly positions itself around aerogel composite materials, EV battery thermal-protection products, and insulation materials for marine, piping, and building use.

Coverage and Focus

  • Coverage Area: China-wide service footprint with nationwide customer support.
  • Focus Areas: New-energy vehicle battery thermal barriers, marine insulation, pipeline insulation, and exterior-wall insulation systems.

Main Products and Capacity

  • Aerogel composite materials
  • Thermal-insulation and flame-retardant materials for new-energy vehicles
  • Building exterior-wall insulation products
  • Pipeline insulation products
  • Public Capacity: 1 million sqm annually according to the official company profile.

Production Sites and Certifications

  • Main Production Site: Qingpu Industrial Park, Shanghai, China.
  • International Certifications: Public pages mention innovation and qualifications pages, but specific international certificate numbers are not clearly listed on the reviewed pages.
  • Official Website: http://www.grandnew-sh.com/

FAQ

What products does Shanghai Grandnew make?

Grandnew publicly lists aerogel composite materials, EV battery insulation and flame-retardant products, building exterior-wall insulation products, and pipeline insulation products.

Where is Shanghai Grandnew located?

The company lists Qingpu Industrial Park in Shanghai as its operating location and says it serves customers across China.

Does Grandnew disclose production scale?

Yes. Its public company profile states an annual production capacity of 1 million square meters.
